ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity black pixels and 35% high-intensity white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and lower regions consist of solid low-intensity black pixels. High-intensity white pixels form contiguous patches and mottling localized along the trailing edges and lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in vertical amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-15 circular, high-contrast white ring formations (rosettes) concentrated on the black surface of the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal high-intensity linear scratch on the inner right lobe near the notch, and multiple fine vertical striations on the outer left lobe margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of acorn barnacles creating a raised, high-relief beige/white texture on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
